History, poetry, and photography inform the way I observe places and people. I am especially interested in how ordinary spaces carry traces of lives that have changed or disappeared.

## Writing

I write in Chinese, with interests in poetry, history, and the experience of place. I value precision and restraint: the possibility that a small detail can carry a larger sense of time or loss.

### [Alone in the West Wind, Counting the Departing Crows](family-history.qmd)

A family history from Yanmen Pass to Taiyuan, pieced together from household stories, local gazetteers, and a Ming military appointment register.

[Read in English](family-history.qmd) · [中文原文](family-history-zh.qmd){lang=zh-CN hreflang=zh-CN}

## Photography

Photography offers another way to attend to everyday surroundings: streets, light, buildings, and the relationships between people and places.

These interests accompany my academic work and give me other ways to notice, describe, and ask questions.
